page_title: WOL 2-0 MNU | Wolves v Manchester Utd 26/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+9' 2 - 0 Goal! Matheus Cunha passes the ball to the feet of Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves), who has an empty net in front of him and has no problems in tapping the ball in. 2:0.
90+6' Tony Harrington blows his whistle and signals a foul after Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) brought his opponent down. Wolves are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
90+6' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
90+4' Antony (Manchester United) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
90+4' The ball possession is 51:49.
90+2' Here is a change. Nelson Semedo is going off and Vitor Pereira gives the last tactical orders to Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves).
90+2' Here comes a substitution. Craig Dawson (Wolves) is brought on as a substitute for Jorgen Strand Larsen.
90+1' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

90+1' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) fails to deliver a cross from the free kick as his attempt is thwarted by the opposition's defence. The linesman makes the right call and Manchester Utd will have a corner.
90' 8 additional min. will be played.
90' Yellow card. Matt Doherty (Wolves) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
89' Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
88' Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United) serves up a nice cross, but Jose Sa punches the ball away.
87' Vitor Pereira decides to make a substitution. Rayan Ait-Nouri will be replaced by Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves).
84' The resulting corner from Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

84' Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. Manchester Utd force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
83' Wonderful movement by Manchester Utd. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
82' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) wins himself enough space to connect with a cross inside the box, but his fine header goes narrowly over the crossbar!
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Amad Diallo departs the field of play to be replaced by Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United).
79' Ruben Amorim prepares a substitution. Rasmus Hojlund is replaced by Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United).
79' 6:8 – the total goal attempt statistics.
79' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
77' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) has a goal ruled out for offside!
74' Vitor Pereira has decided to substitute Goncalo Guedes and he is replaced by Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves).
73' Substitution. Thomas Doyle (Wolves) replaces Joao Gomes.
72' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Christian Eriksen (Manchester United), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.

72' Joao Gomes (Wolves) brings his opponent down. Tony Harrington has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Manchester Utd will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
70' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) was too forceful with his tackle and Tony Harrington interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
70' Antony (Manchester United) finds some space on the edge of the box after some nice individual play and curls a shot in on goal, but the ball flies just wide of the right post.
69' Half-chance! Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) plays a pass into the box, but Andre Onana reacts well to snuff out the attack.
68' An accurate cross finds its way to Casemiro (Manchester United) who sends in a bullet header towards the middle of the target from just outside the box, but the goalkeeper makes the save.
63' The referee signals a substitution. Antony (Manchester United) is brought on as a substitute for Leny Yoro.
63' Ruben Amorim has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Casemiro (Manchester United) replacing Kobbie Mainoo.
63' That's the end of the game for Manuel Ugarte, who is replaced by Christian Eriksen (Manchester United).
60' Corner kicks – 4:2.
58' 1 - 0 Unbelievable! Matheus Cunha (Wolves) scores direct from the corner. He curls the ball and it goes straight into the back of the net. 1:0.
58' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
54' The yellow card goes to Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United).
52' The flag is raised and Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) is offside again, not for the first time today.
50' The Wolves players’ celebrations are quickly cut short after referee Tony Harrington signals NO GOAL following the VAR review due to an offside.
49' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee Tony Harrington is going to take a look using VAR.
49' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.

47' Tony Harrington blows his whistle and Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is shown a second yellow card for his foul. His manager will not be pleased. He has lot of time to think about it as he walks off.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' Tony Harrington has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
44' 39:61 – the ratio of ball possession.
41' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
40' Joao Gomes (Wolves) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.
40' Wolves take a short corner kick.

39' What a great effort! Nelson Semedo (Wolves) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the right post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal.
39' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Joao Gomes (Wolves) took the corner.

39' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. Wolves earn a corner.
36' A pass by Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.
36' Leny Yoro (Manchester United) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.

35' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Wolves are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.

34' Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United) finds himself some space around the penalty spot and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the left side of the goal, but Jose Sa keeps it out.
33' Joao Gomes (Wolves) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Tony Harrington had an easy-decision to make.
30' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
29' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

29' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) inside the box following a slide rule pass. The referee blows his whistle, Manchester Utd are awarded a corner kick.
27' Goncalo Guedes (Wolves) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

26' Andre Onana pulls off a fantastic save! Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the top right corner, but the effort is kept out. The ball goes out of play. Wolves are awarded a corner kick.
25' Goncalo Guedes (Wolves) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
25' Jose Sa displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
23' What a long-range shot by Goncalo Guedes (Wolves). Unfortunately for him, his shot goes just a few inches over the bar.
21' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

20' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the right post is blocked by Jose Sa, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
18' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
17' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
15' Wonderful pass from Goncalo Guedes (Wolves) for Jorgen Strand Larsen, but they can't profit from it as Andre Onana comes off his line to collect.

13' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
12' A clumsy foul by Joao Gomes (Wolves) and Tony Harrington blows his whistle. There is a free kick near the sideline to Manchester Utd.
11' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
10' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
9' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.

7' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
4' What was Leny Yoro (Manchester United) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
1' Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Manchester Utd will have the kick-off.
Tony Harrington will referee today's match.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
